chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi takes Gu Suizhou to an upscale restaurant to celebrate his promotion to a research assistant at W.N. During the meal, Shen Feizhi reveals he has been investigating Gu Suizhou's background and points out a major shareholder of W.N. present in the restaurant, pressuring Gu Suizhou to obtain the man's contact information. The chapter highlights the shifting power dynamic and Shen Feizhi's hidden agenda regarding Gu Suizhou's family legacy.
